$comment: The source of sf-gallery's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/gallery (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

layout.summary: How the pictures stand (owner decision C150 (1)). grid, the default: a grid of picture tiles. thumbnails: the main picture, whole in its frame, with a row of thumbnails under it and the place «3 / 12» -- a product card. A row that scrolls is sf-slider (C143), not a gallery look.

tile-size.summary: The grid's tile minimum (C150 (2)): s 6rem (96), m 10rem (160, the default), l 15rem (240). As many columns as fit at that minimum, never fewer than three (s), two (m) or one (l), so a phone keeps a grid. The gap is one group's, --sf-space-1/3 (8; 4 in compact density, C150 (3)).

ratio.summary: One shape for every tile (C150 (4)): 1/1 (the default), 4/3 or 16/9, the picture covering the tile around its focus point -- the picture's object-position, which the image field writes from its focus {x, y} (C94 (3)); auto keeps each picture's own shape, uncropped. With layout thumbnails a written ratio is the main frame's (4/3 without one), the picture whole in it.

caption.summary: Where a picture's caption shows (C150 (5)). viewer, the default: only in the viewer, under the picture. under: also under each tile, small and muted, whole lines (C92 view 8) -- news, a portfolio. The caption is the figure's figcaption, else the child's data-caption or title.

selection.summary: Choosing pictures, a media library (C150 (9)). many: a check box in each tile's start corner on a popup plate, shown on hover and focus and on every tile once anything is chosen; then a press on a tile chooses it, Shift a range; a bar «Выбрано N» with the page's actions (slot actions) and «Снять выбор» stands over the grid; a phone chooses by a long press. Escape clears. The choice is the value selected and the event select.

heading.summary: The set's name: the grid's and the thumbnails' accessible name and the viewer's. Empty: «Галерея» on a Russian page, «Gallery» on an English one.

inline.summary: Shows the pictures on the page (true, the default). false draws nothing on the page: the pictures show only in the viewer, opened by open().

lightbox.summary: A press on a picture opens the full-screen viewer (true, the default; C150 (7)). false: the tiles are pictures only.

loop.summary: In the viewer and with next() / prev(), the last picture is followed by the first.

open.summary: The viewer is open: setting it opens the full-screen viewer at the current picture, removing it closes it.

current.summary: The one-based picture the thumbnails look shows and the viewer opens at; the gallery writes it back as the person pages, kept within 1 and the number of pictures.

selected.summary: With selection many, the chosen pictures' one-based numbers in order. A page may write it (a list, or numbers separated by commas or spaces in the attribute) to choose.

change.x-summary: The current picture changed: in the viewer (from lightbox), by a thumbnail (from inline) or by an action (from api)

select.x-summary: The choice changed (selection many): the chosen pictures' one-based numbers, their count and the number of pictures. Its DOM name is sf-gallery-select.

open.x-summary: Opens the viewer, at index when given; refused (no-lightbox) with lightbox false, (empty) without pictures
open.summary: Moves to the given one-based picture when an index is passed, sets open and opens the full-screen viewer there. Answers an outcome.

x-returns.description: The outcome: {outcome: applied} or {outcome: refused, reason}.

close.x-summary: Closes the viewer; refused (closed) when it is closed
close.summary: Closes the viewer and removes open; the focus goes back to the tile of the picture shown last. Answers an outcome.

x-returns.description: The outcome: {outcome: applied} or {outcome: refused, reason}.

toggle.summary: close() when the viewer is open, open(index) otherwise. Answers an outcome.

x-returns.description: The outcome: {outcome: applied} or {outcome: refused, reason}.

go-to.x-summary: Shows the picture at index (1-based, clamped to the pictures)
go-to.summary: Moves to a one-based picture, clamped to the count, reflects it to current, moves the open viewer there and sends change when it moved. Answers an outcome.

x-returns.description: The outcome: {outcome: applied} or {outcome: refused, reason}.

next.summary: goTo(current + 1); stops at the last picture unless loop. Answers an outcome.

x-returns.description: The outcome: {outcome: applied} or {outcome: refused, reason}.

prev.summary: goTo(current - 1); stops at the first picture unless loop. Answers an outcome.

x-returns.description: The outcome: {outcome: applied} or {outcome: refused, reason}.

clear-selection.x-summary: Clears the choice; refused (empty) when nothing is chosen
clear-selection.summary: Clears the choice (selection many) and sends select. Answers an outcome.

x-returns.description: The outcome: {outcome: applied} or {outcome: refused, reason}.

slide.$comment: Each child of the host is a picture of the set (§4.5): an (its alt, width and height, its object-position the focus point), a , a

actions.$comment: The page's actions in the selection bar «Выбрано N» (selection many): sf-button size 1/2, ghost on-surface, as in the C150 prototype.

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16).

accessibility.$comment: The grid is a list named by heading; each tile a list item whose picture is a button «Открыть фото 3 из 12: <alt>» (aria-haspopup dialog) -- named by its action (W3C WAI images tutorial). The thumbnails are a group of buttons «Показать фото N», one Tab stop, ← → Home End move and show (mirrored right to left), the shown one aria-current; the place «3 / 12» is polite. Selection: a real check box per tile «Выбрать фото N: <alt>», the bar a region «Выбор» with «Выбрано N» polite and «Снять выбор»; Escape clears. The viewer is a modal <dialog> named by heading, black in both themes: the focus goes to «Закрыть»; ← → (mirrored), Home, End page, + and − zoom, the arrow keys pan a zoomed picture, Escape un-zooms then closes; the place «3 / 12» is polite; closing gives the focus back to the tile of the picture shown last.

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-gallery for the shim (core/js/aliases.js, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (the shim sends the new and the old name), detail-adds (the new detail holds the old fields), attribute-and-property, host-attribute (no shim), manifest-only (the DOM name does not change), retired (no new name; kept and noted by the component until the date).

x-summary: A set of pictures: a grid of picture tiles (or the main picture with thumbnails) that opens the page's full-screen viewer, with an optional choice of tiles for a media library. The viewer is SF.Gallery.view(items, options), shared with sf-file-preview.
x-renamed: settings.title → heading: "title" is a property of HTMLElement.prototype (§3.1, §16 item 26), alias dated
settings.blur → backdrop-blur: "blur" is a property of HTMLElement.prototype (§3.1, §16 item 26), alias dated
events.change: 3 carried field(s) held the element, not data (§8)
events.sf-change → change (the DOM name without sf-<tag>-)
events.close: 3 carried field(s) held the element, not data (§8)
events.sf-close → close (the DOM name without sf-<tag>-)
events.open: 3 carried field(s) held the element, not data (§8)
events.sf-open → open (the DOM name without sf-<tag>-)
settings.button-size: type string with the numeral default "1" → number (§16 item 29)
settings.dots-size: type string with the numeral default "2" → number (§16 item 29)

events.open → opened and close → closed: they are sent after the lightbox opened or closed, so they are facts and take the past form (§8, vocabulary §4); the DOM names are sf-gallery-opened and sf-gallery-closed
methods.getModal, getInlineSlider, getLightboxSlider: readers retire (§4.4), kept and noted until the date
x-decisions: version: 1.0.0 → 1.1.0: title, blur, sf-change, sf-open, sf-close and the three readers are dated rows, the actions answer outcomes; a minor while the rows hold (§4.10).

events: change {previous, current, total, from} keeps the DOM name change (§8); the lightbox's facts are opened and closed {current, total} (sf-gallery-opened, -closed), sent after the modal opened or closed, so the past form. sf-change, sf-open and sf-close follow with the same detail until 2026-12-01; component, tagName and template leave the detail (§8). A nested slider's change stops at the gallery, which reports it as its own change.
a11y-role: none on the root. The inline view is sf-slider; the lightbox is sf-modal (role dialog, named by heading, traps focus, Escape closes when close-on-esc).
key-effects: Enter and Space on a [data-sf-gallery-open] trigger open the lightbox (open); Tab reaches the slider's and the modal's controls.
number-type: button-size and dots-size are steps of the size ladder (1/2, 1, 2) handed to sf-slider, not numbers; they stay strings. current is an integer from 1.
words: the lightbox's heading was the English «Gallery» on every page; it is the language file's word now (heading default-from runtime.heading: «Галерея», «Gallery»).

lightbox: the template hands sf-modal its own names, heading and backdrop-blur, so the modal's dated aliases are not used by the Framework itself; a trigger's data-sf-modal-title and data-sf-modal-blur keep configuring the delegated lightbox.
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js and styles its sheet js/templates/default.css, the migration form §5.2 allows.
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json and studio.scenario.json plus the lightbox and the actions; probe.json drives go-to, next, open, close and the aliases.
skeleton: block, none while loading; the pictures are the page's children, laid out as the grid by core.styles before any code (C150 (6)); the viewer is closed at first paint (§5.4).

css-variables: five public variables read by the gallery's own sheet: the root's narrowest size, the thumbnails look's fit, and the viewer's picture height, picture area and caption colour (src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json).

version 1.1.1: the first-paint snapshots are retaken: the JSON island is printed once (no held copy), the icon font's state (sf-icon loaded, sf-icon-loaded) is left out, a closed surface prints closed and a size or place the code measured (a non-zero px width, height, inset, clip or transform) is left out, so a snapshot is the same on every run.

version 1.1.2: the first-paint sheet list names the utility sheets its templates draw with (core.runtime 1.0.7 asks for them before the element draws: the style gate). The slide attributes are printed in the order the element sets them.

version 1.3.0 (2026-11-14, owner decision C150, gallery study ui-control control/research/2026-11-14-gallery.md, prototype prototypes/gallery-study.html): a minor; the gallery is a grid and a full-screen viewer, not a slider and a window. (1) layout grid (default) or thumbnails (main picture whole in a 4/3 frame, thumbnails 72 one Tab stop, «3 / 12»); a scrolling row is sf-slider. (2) tile-size s/m/l: as many columns as fit at 96/160/240, at least 3/2/1. (3) gap --sf-space-1/3 (8, compact 4). (4) ratio 1/1 (default), 4/3, 16/9, auto: one shape, cover around the picture's object-position (the image field's focus point). (5) caption viewer (default) or under. (6) The tile holds its shape and the quiet fill from the first frame (core.styles draws the same grid for an undefined sf-gallery; the children stay until the drawing takes them, holdsSlotNodesUntilDrawn), pictures lazy, 0 shift. (7) The viewer (js/viewer.js, SF.Gallery.view, a native modal dialog): full screen, black in both themes, «3 / 12» at the start, Zoom and Close at the end 8 apart, side arrows (none under md: swipe), the caption under the picture, ← → Home End, Escape, the focus back to the tile, a swipe down closes, controls in the over-photo look (C14 (3)). (8) Zoom: double click or double tap to the picture's own pixels (at least 2x) at that point, drag pans, + and −, the Zoom button, pinch; no rotation or filters. (9) selection many: check boxes on popup plates, Shift range, «Выбрано N» bar with slot actions, long press on a phone; value selected, event select (sf-gallery-select), action clear-selection. (10) The tile is component.figure 1.3.0's .sf-figure--tile in .sf-figure-grid, for sf-gallery, the C81 gallery look, ui-mail «Изображения» and SIMAI Pro chat previews. The viewer also shows video (the browser's player) and PDF (the browser's viewer in a frame) for sf-file-preview (C149 (6)). 36 settings of the slider and the window retire (aliases.json, journal setting-sf-gallery-slider-and-window-retired): read, noted in SF.deprecations, drawing nothing until 2027-01-01. Relations: cl-button-icon, cl-button-close, figure, checkbox (cl-slider and cl-modal leave). Focus return: one path (the viewer's), replacing GL-5's and FP-10's. Masonry waits (C150 question 11).

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-gallery for a set of pictures: a grid of tiles by default (layout thumbnails for a product card), one shape for all tiles, a press opening the full-screen viewer; selection many for a media library. For a row that scrolls use sf-slider. To show any list of pictures, videos or PDF files full screen from page code, call SF.Gallery.view(items, {start}) after SF.Loader.ensure(['sf-gallery']).
do_not: Do not draw a picture grid or a lightbox of your own: the tile is .sf-figure--tile in a .sf-figure-grid (component.figure) and the viewer is SF.Gallery.view.
Do not import js/viewer.js into another bundle: ask for sf-gallery and call SF.Gallery, so the page has one viewer.
Give each picture its width and height and its focus point as object-position; do not crop pictures on the server for the grid.
The slider and modal settings (arrows, dots, thumbs, width, height, overlay, ...) are retired and draw nothing.
Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
